pr_title: Reduce word counts and add anti-echoing guidance to enrich fields
pr_description: Reduced word counts**: description 80-100 → 50-70 words, synergy/conflict 40-60 → 20-40 words. ~35% less output per lever, helping gpt-oss-20b (reasoning model) stay within 600s plan budget. Anti-echoing**: "Do NOT repeat the consequences or review fields — add new insight about why this lever matters and what success looks like." Targets llama3.1 consequence echoing (0.76x baseline description length). Pydantic field descriptions updated to match system prompt.
